options.content:
**What this answers:** the cheapest tours a visitor can take, within a budget, with the places they want. Pick inputs above, then click a tour number in the table to see its legs and map.

**Try:** [Hanoi, 5 stops, at most 500k ₫](/d/br1-finder?var-city=hanoi&var-stops=5&var-budget=500000) · [HCMC tours that visit Miếu Ngũ Hành](/d/br1-finder?var-city=hcmc&var-must_visit=Mi%E1%BA%BFu%20Ng%C5%A9%20H%C3%A0nh) · [Da Nang tours with a place of worship](/d/br1-finder?var-city=danang&var-category=place_of_worship) · [All cities: cheapest tour per stop count](/d/br1-finder?var-city=hcmc) (switch City to compare)

panels.description: How many pre-solved tours fit my city, stop count, budget and must-have places?

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT groupArray(osm_id) FROM tour.dim_landmark WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND category IN (${category:singlequote})) AS cat_ids SELECT count() FROM tour.fact_tour FINAL WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND toString(n_stops) IN (${stops:singlequote}) AND total_cost_vnd <= ${budget} AND ('__any' IN (${must_visit:singlequote}) OR hasAll(stop_names, [${must_visit:singlequote}])) AND ('__any' IN (${category:singlequote}) OR arrayExists(id -> has(cat_ids, id), stop_ids))

panels.title: Matching tours

panels.description: What is the lowest price I can pay for a tour that meets my criteria?

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT groupArray(osm_id) FROM tour.dim_landmark WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND category IN (${category:singlequote})) AS cat_ids SELECT min(total_cost_vnd) FROM tour.fact_tour FINAL WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND toString(n_stops) IN (${stops:singlequote}) AND total_cost_vnd <= ${budget} AND ('__any' IN (${must_visit:singlequote}) OR hasAll(stop_names, [${must_visit:singlequote}])) AND ('__any' IN (${category:singlequote}) OR arrayExists(id -> has(cat_ids, id), stop_ids))

panels.title: Cheapest tour

panels.description: What does a typical matching tour cost, so I know if a price is a good deal?

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT groupArray(osm_id) FROM tour.dim_landmark WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND category IN (${category:singlequote})) AS cat_ids SELECT quantileExact(0.5)(total_cost_vnd) FROM tour.fact_tour FINAL WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND toString(n_stops) IN (${stops:singlequote}) AND total_cost_vnd <= ${budget} AND ('__any' IN (${must_visit:singlequote}) OR hasAll(stop_names, [${must_visit:singlequote}])) AND ('__any' IN (${category:singlequote}) OR arrayExists(id -> has(cat_ids, id), stop_ids))

panels.title: Median tour cost

panels.description: How little walking or driving do I need for a tour that meets my criteria?

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT groupArray(osm_id) FROM tour.dim_landmark WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND category IN (${category:singlequote})) AS cat_ids SELECT min(total_km) FROM tour.fact_tour FINAL WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND toString(n_stops) IN (${stops:singlequote}) AND total_cost_vnd <= ${budget} AND ('__any' IN (${must_visit:singlequote}) OR hasAll(stop_names, [${must_visit:singlequote}])) AND ('__any' IN (${category:singlequote}) OR arrayExists(id -> has(cat_ids, id), stop_ids))

panels.title: Shortest tour

panels.description: Which tours fit my budget and wishes, and which is cheapest? Click a tour number to inspect it below.

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT groupArray(osm_id) FROM tour.dim_landmark WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND category IN (${category:singlequote})) AS cat_ids SELECT request_id AS tour, n_stops AS stops, round(total_km, 1) AS km, total_fare_vnd AS transport_vnd, total_ticket_vnd AS tickets_vnd, total_cost_vnd AS total_vnd, arrayStringConcat(stop_names, ' → ') AS route FROM tour.fact_tour FINAL WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND toString(n_stops) IN (${stops:singlequote}) AND total_cost_vnd <= ${budget} AND ('__any' IN (${must_visit:singlequote}) OR hasAll(stop_names, [${must_visit:singlequote}])) AND ('__any' IN (${category:singlequote}) OR arrayExists(id -> has(cat_ids, id), stop_ids)) ORDER BY total_cost_vnd, total_km LIMIT 100

panels.title: Tours within budget, cheapest first

panels.description: For each number of stops, what is the cheapest matching tour and how many options exist?

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT groupArray(osm_id) FROM tour.dim_landmark WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND category IN (${category:singlequote})) AS cat_ids SELECT n_stops AS stops, count() AS tours, min(total_cost_vnd) AS cheapest_vnd, argMin(request_id, total_cost_vnd) AS tour, argMin(arrayStringConcat(stop_names, ' → '), total_cost_vnd) AS route FROM tour.fact_tour FINAL WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND toString(n_stops) IN (${stops:singlequote}) AND total_cost_vnd <= ${budget} AND ('__any' IN (${must_visit:singlequote}) OR hasAll(stop_names, [${must_visit:singlequote}])) AND ('__any' IN (${category:singlequote}) OR arrayExists(id -> has(cat_ids, id), stop_ids)) GROUP BY n_stops ORDER BY n_stops

panels.title: Cheapest tour for each number of stops

panels.description: Where does my money go on the selected tour, stop by stop?

targets.rawSql: SELECT seq, to_name AS stop, round(leg_km, 2) AS leg_km, leg_fare_vnd, ticket_vnd, cum_cost_vnd AS running_total_vnd FROM tour.fact_tour_leg FINAL WHERE request_id = toUInt64OrZero(${tour:singlequote}) ORDER BY seq

panels.title: Leg-by-leg cost

panels.description: Where are the stops of the selected tour and in what order do I visit them?

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.seq AS seq, concat(toString(l.seq), '. ', l.to_name) AS label, d.lat AS lat, d.lon AS lon, l.cum_cost_vnd AS running_total_vnd FROM tour.fact_tour_leg AS l FINAL INNER JOIN tour.dim_landmark AS d ON d.osm_id = l.to_id AND d.city = ${city:singlequote} WHERE l.request_id = toUInt64OrZero(${tour:singlequote}) ORDER BY seq

panels.title: Route on the map

panels.description: For a given number of stops, is the money going to transport or to tickets?

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT groupArray(osm_id) FROM tour.dim_landmark WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND category IN (${category:singlequote})) AS cat_ids SELECT toString(n_stops) AS stops, round(avg(total_fare_vnd)) AS transport_vnd, round(avg(total_ticket_vnd)) AS tickets_vnd FROM tour.fact_tour FINAL WHERE city = ${city:singlequote} AND toString(n_stops) IN (${stops:singlequote}) AND total_cost_vnd <= ${budget} AND ('__any' IN (${must_visit:singlequote}) OR hasAll(stop_names, [${must_visit:singlequote}])) AND ('__any' IN (${category:singlequote}) OR arrayExists(id -> has(cat_ids, id), stop_ids)) GROUP BY n_stops ORDER BY n_stops
